assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Draw ONE flat 2D board-game building sprite from the FRONT, like an illustrated cardboard standee. Genuine transparent PNG square canvas512x512, object inside x60..452,y40..420, bottom contact middle (256,420). Keep broad simple readable silhouette at 48px height. No isometric view, no top-down view, no 3D miniature/diorama, no thick rocky plinth or floor base, no external cast shadow, no outlines or sticker border. Two or three big FLAT color shapes per material, no fine triangulation or texture. Fully opaque artwork, smooth antialiased 1–2px silhouette, no alpha holes or matte residue. CREAM STONE is warm yellow-cream with warm ochre shadows (not gray), wood is warm brown. IMPORTANT for team-color separation: ONLY roofs and fabric flag are NEUTRAL GRAYSCALE, white/light gray/base gray/dark gray, RGB gray without blue or purple tint. No other gray anywhere: make flagpole GOLD or BROWN, not metal gray. Paw emblem is warm cream, distinct from gray flag. Gray roofs/flag are not a changed design: code will tint them teal/gold/blue/red/purple later. No words, numbers, UI, people, glow or magical effects. Subject: a small but grand cat CASTLE from the same title castle design family: cream front wall with a big brown arched doorway, a taller CENTER tower and two shorter side towers, three simple pointed roofs, ONE LARGE flag bearing a big cream cat PAW with FOUR toes on the central pole. The castle has FRONT elevation, wall not cylindrical depth-rendered, crenellations just 3–4 big squared notches, TWO tiny dark window shapes total.
